payload.body: #BINANCEUPDATE Most big players are showing great signs of short and mid term increases in value as the weekly close for $BTC has been one of the strongest in history. New supports have been set for all major coins, this is a great indicator for second-movers to seize the day. $BTC is also reaching an ATH, which means other coins have become extremely undervalued in comparison, starting with $ETH , which is now one of the greatest long term holds out there
